entities.name: Creature class
entities.description: Informal creature types describing what a creature does (Rogue, Soldier, Wizard) as opposed to species types.

entities.name: Grand Creature Type Update
entities.description: A rules update that consolidated the race/class model, reducing creature types and issuing errata.

entities.name: Onslaught block
entities.description: A tribal-themed block whose development prompted R&D's shift to creature-types-as-mechanics.

events.summary: Development of Onslaught block drives R&D to shift from creature types as flavor to creature types as mechanics.
events.quote: Classes were a major part of R&D's shift away from creature-types-as-flavour to creature-types-as-mechanics.

events.summary: The race/class model is adopted from Mirrodin onwards and consolidated by the Grand Creature Type Update.
events.quote: the race/class model was adopted for creatures from Mirrodin onwards.

events.summary: Child and Gamer become eternal legal classes with Unfinity.
events.quote: The release of Unfinity saw Child and Gamer become eternal legal classes.
